title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
description:
About Dynime
Dynime is an AI-powered digital transformation company helping businesses build, operate, automate, and scale their digital infrastructure across technology, software, digital services, automation, business infrastructure, and international markets.
We are seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer to lead Dynime's next stage of growth and build a scalable, profitable, technology-driven, internationally competitive organization.
Role Overview
The CEO is responsible for Dynime's overall strategic direction, business performance, growth, profitability, culture, organizational development, and long-term value creation. The successful candidate will lead the executive team, establish company-wide priorities, drive sustainable revenue growth, develop strategic relationships, oversee financial and operational performance, support international expansion, and ensure strong execution of Dynime's business strategy.
Primary Objectives
The CEO will be responsible for:

• Establishing and executing Dynime's long-term vision and strategy.

• Driving sustainable revenue and customer growth.

• Improving profitability and financial sustainability.

• Expanding Dynime into international markets.

• Strengthening products, technology, AI, and automation initiatives.

• Building scalable operational systems and leadership structures.

• Developing a high-performance executive team and company culture.

• Building strategic customer, partner, and stakeholder relationships.

• Protecting the company's reputation, assets, and long-term interests.

Key Responsibilities
Corporate Strategy

• Define Dynime's long-term corporate strategy and strategic priorities.

• Establish annual, quarterly, and multi-year objectives.

• Translate strategy into measurable business plans and KPIs.

• Evaluate new products, services, markets, and business models.

• Monitor competitors, market conditions, and growth opportunities.

• Ensure departments remain aligned with company strategy.

Business Growth & Commercial Leadership

• Own the overall company growth strategy.

• Develop new revenue streams and commercial opportunities.

• Expand the international customer base.

• Support enterprise sales and strategic negotiations.

• Build strategic partnerships and business relationships.

• Work closely with the CCO, VP Sales, and business development leadership.

• Review sales pipeline, forecasts, pricing, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.

• Identify opportunities for strategic investments, acquisitions, or alliances.

Financial Performance

• Maintain executive ownership of company-level financial performance.

• Work with the CFO on budgets, forecasts, cash flow, profitability, and financial planning.

• Monitor revenue, margins, operating expenses, and financial sustainability.

• Establish company financial targets.

• Ensure responsible allocation of resources and major expenditures.

• Make informed decisions using financial and operational data.

Executive Leadership

• Lead Dynime's executive leadership team.

• Establish clear responsibilities, priorities, and accountability.

• Review executive performance and departmental KPIs.

• Resolve executive-level conflicts and organizational issues.

• Develop future senior and executive leaders.

• Promote ownership, accountability, transparency, and execution.

International Expansion

• Establish international market priorities and expansion strategies.

• Identify high-potential countries and regions.

• Evaluate market-entry opportunities.

• Support regional leadership and international sales teams.

• Build international strategic partnerships.

• Monitor international revenue and market performance.

• Maintain consistent global positioning.

Priority markets may include North America, Europe, United Kingdom, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and Africa.
Technology, AI & Product

• Work closely with the CTO on technology strategy and product development.

title: Sales Trainer US
description:
Description
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market .
This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.
What you will do

•
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires , running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market .

•
Train regular cohorts of new hires - currently around 4-5 people once a month , with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.

•
Develop practical sales skills , including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.

•
Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools , including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms .

•
Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.

•
Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks , identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.

•
Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.

•
Maintain and improve onboarding materials , including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.

•
Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

Requirements

•
Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.

•
2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience , ideally working directly with sales teams.

•
Native-level Spanish and fluent English , with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.

•
Strong communication and facilitation skills - you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.

•
Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.

•
Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.

•
Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.

•

title: Country People Partner
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Country People Partner, you will provide dedicated People support for assigned country or multi-country operations within the VGo Carrier and Fulfilment business units, with a strong focus on the Netherlands. You will act as the main People point of contact for local and remote leaders, ensuring smooth day-to-day People operations, strong employee relations support, and compliance with local employment laws.

You will be part of the People team and report to the Country People Lead, Vinted Go Operations. In this role, you will work closely with Operations, Shared Services, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and the Carrier & Fulfilment People Lead to support both operational and strategic People processes.

This is a dynamic role combining operational HR, employee relations, legal compliance, and strategic partnering in a fast-paced, international environment.

The position is based in Breda.

In this position, you’ll 

• Serve as the main People point of contact for leaders across assigned countries and operational units, with a focus on the Netherlands.

• Provide guidance on employee relations topics, including performance management, disciplinary cases, grievances, misconduct, reorganizations, redundancies, exits, and burnout prevention.

• Independently manage routine employee relations cases and escalate complex or high-risk matters where needed.

• Ensure accurate and compliant documentation of all People activities and employee relations cases.

• Work closely with the Shared Service Center on onboarding, offboarding, employee documentation, and Workday updates.

• Ensure internal policies and People processes comply with local employment laws.

• Support organizational changes, restructuring, and redundancy procedures.

• Use people analytics and engagement data to identify insights, support leadership discussions, and define focus areas for managers.

• Partner on key People cycles, including performance reviews, talent reviews, calibrations, and compensation evaluations.

• Collaborate with Talent Acquisition on hiring strategies and workforce planning.

• Facilitate local People initiatives, workshops, leadership sessions, and operational projects.

• Act as the primary contact for temporary workforce matters, working with internal stakeholders, Legal, and external providers.

About you 

• Have experience in HR, People Partnering, or a similar role, ideally within an operational environment such as logistics, carrier, fulfilment, or warehouse operations.

title: Marketing Manager, Diagnostics
description:

For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

We're looking for an organized, innovative marketing professional to serve as the operational engine behind our Diagnostics arm of our marketing team. You'll be the person who makes things happen, turning strategy into action, managing our tech stack, coordinating event participation, owning customer communication, and building systems that help our marketing and sales teams work smarter.

• Coordinate event logistics: registration, booth materials, swag, vendor communications, budget tracking

• Develop pre- and post-event outreach strategies, including attendee targeting and follow-up campaigns

Thought Leadership & Media Relations

• Identify award opportunities and manage submissions from application to announcement

• Scout podcast and speaking opportunities for our subject matter experts

• Bachelors degree and 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or Marketing Analytics

• Deep expertise with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

• Experience in medical device, diagnostics, marketing

• Familiarity with FDA-regulated promotional content and compliance review processes

• Experience with Framer, Webflow, or similar no-code CMS platforms

• Background supporting a dual or multi-audience brand

• Basic design literacy; experience providing feedback on marketing collateral

title: Mechanical Design Engineer – CAD & Manufacturing
description:
Role Title: Mechanical Design Engineer - CAD & Manufacturing
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Mechanical Design Engineer - CAD & Manufacturing experts to contribute technical expertise on a customer's engineering project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Create and interpret professional engineering drawings, ensuring all relevant details are conveyed for manufacturing.

• Translate complex design requirements into clear, manufacturable CAD specifications, with a focus on accuracy and precision.

• Produce detailed 2D and 3D models using industry-standard tools (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, Inventor, Creo, NX) and reference models in FreeCAD.

• Apply advanced principles of tolerancing, dimensioning, and Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) to all deliverables.

• Document and communicate manufacturing processes and design intent in clear, well-structured written and verbal formats.

• Review, critique, and improve existing engineering documentation to enhance clarity and manufacturability.

• Contribute insights on design for manufacture (DFM) and help optimize parts for real-world production scenarios.

Preferred Qualifications

• Extensive industry experience in mechanical design, with parts successfully transitioned from concept through to manufacturing.

• Expert-level proficiency in CAD software, with demonstrated capability across multiple platforms (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, Inventor, Creo, NX).

• Solid hands-on knowledge of FreeCAD for interpreting or referencing models.

• Strong command of drafting standards, GD&T, tolerancing, and the creation of technical documentation suitable for manufacturing.

• Deep understanding of various manufacturing processes, material selection, and DFM best practices.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to document decisions and explain engineering concepts clearly.

• Experience collaborating on engineering projects remotely and sharing feedback in a constructive, professional manner.

And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.
English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.
Concretely, you will:

Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.
Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle
Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.
Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

title: Electric Propulsion Test Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

ROLE

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job.

As Electric Propulsion Test Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit's own vacuum facilities.

You work shoulder to shoulder with our propulsion engineers. You build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Plan and build

- Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

- Design and implement test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing.

- Assemble and maintain test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities.

Test and analyse

- Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests.

- Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results.

- Feed findings back to the design team quickly so each iteration improves on the last.

Verify and document

About Us

We are developing potentially best in class therapies for patients living with severe autoimmune diseases. Our lead antibody, claseprubart (DNTH103), is purposefully engineered with extended half-life, improved potency, and high selectivity for only the active C1s complement protein that drives disease pathology - enabling less frequent and more convenient self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our second clinical candidate, DNTH212 is a first and potentially best in class, bifunctional inhibitor that targets clinically validated and complementary disease modifying mechanisms, Type 1 IFN suppression and B cell modulation - enabling potential for improved clinical outcomes and patient friendly convenient, self-administered subcutaneous injections. To learn more, please visit www.dianthustx.com  and follow us on  LinkedIn .

The Executive Director, Head of Bioanalytical Sciences will lead the company’s bioanalytical strategy and execution across research, translational, and clinical development. • Define and execute the company-wide bioanalytical strategy, operating model, standards, and capability roadmap in alignment with portfolio priorities and development plans.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Data Core (remote, Europe)
description:
Remote - Data Core Team - Full-time
Hey, I'm Andrei. I’m hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Core team at Modash.
Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies-including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN-use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.
Every one of those products depends on fresh, reliable creator data. Data Core owns the systems that collect and maintain profiles for 400M+ creators across social platforms, process billions of data points, and keep the rest of Modash supplied with the raw material it needs.
That’s where you come in.
Why we're hiring
Data Core isn't an internal support team. It owns the collection infrastructure that the entire Modash product-and every downstream data team-depends on.
Collecting social data at this scale is a hard distributed-systems problem. APIs change without warning. Providers become unreliable. Platforms rate-limit requests. Data grows stale. A tiny inefficiency becomes expensive when repeated hundreds of millions of times.
We need a senior engineer who can design resilient services, make thoughtful tradeoffs between coverage, freshness, reliability, and cost, and take production-critical systems from a rough idea to dependable operation.
You’ll join the specialised Data Core team and work closely with Data Search, Data Insights, product teams, and company leadership. You’ll have real ownership, but you won’t work in isolation.
If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.
What you'll actually own
1. Keep creator data flowing at massive scale.
You’ll build and evolve the systems that collect and maintain 400M+ creator profiles across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube-keeping billions of data points fresh enough for search, analytics, APIs, and customer-facing products.
2. Make collection resilient when the outside world isn't.
You’ll design services that handle third-party API instability, rate limits, provider outages, platform changes, and partial failures without turning every disruption into a customer incident.
3. Improve the economics of collection.
At this scale, every request, proxy call, retry, storage decision, and compute cycle matters. You’ll improve coverage and freshness while keeping the system financially sustainable.
4. Own production, not just the code.
You’ll shape the problem, design the architecture, write and review the code, ship it, observe it, and improve it. You’ll build the monitoring and operational safeguards that catch gaps and regressions before customers do.
What the day-to-day looks like
Here’s what a typical week might include:

•
Monday. A social platform has changed its behaviour overnight. Collection success has dropped, but only for part of the traffic. You trace the failure pattern, protect downstream freshness, and design a resilient fix rather than a brittle patch.

•
Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You redesign part of the subscription system that decides which creators to collect, when, and how often-balancing customer value against request and compute cost.

•
Wednesday. You pair with a Data Search engineer on an indexing dependency. Together, you agree on a cleaner contract that improves freshness without coupling the two teams’ systems.

•
Thursday. You review a new request-routing approach across proxy providers. You model throughput, failure modes, and unit economics before shipping a small production experiment.

•
Friday. An observability review reveals a slow coverage regression that existing alerts missed. You improve the data-quality checks so the team catches the next one before it reaches customers.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, harden, and operate systems.

Built large-scale backend or data systems. You have solid

title: Worker’s Compensation Associate Attorney Review – Compromise & Release
description:
Position Overview
Abramson Labor Group is seeking a detail-oriented attorney to join our Associate Review Team. In this role, you will review and edit Compromise and Release (C&R) agreements before they are filed with the WCAB, so that every settlement we submit is accurate, complete, and positioned for approval. This is a high-volume, deadline-driven position suited to someone who works efficiently, stays organized under pressure, and takes pride in getting the details right the first time.
Key Responsibilities

• Review and edit C&R agreements and related addendums prepared by the settlement team, confirming accuracy and completeness before filing.

• Verify settlement terms against the case file, including ADJ numbers, dates of injury, body parts, settlement amounts, attorney fees, permanent disability advances, liens, and future medical provisions.

• Review addendums and attachments, such as Employment Separation Agreements, Medicare-related language, and other supplemental terms, for consistency with the C&R and compliance with WCAB requirements.

• Identify and correct errors, omissions, and problematic language that could result in an Order Suspending Action (OSA) or delay approval.

• Communicate clearly with Settlement Admins and other internal teams about required corrections so documents move through the pipeline without unnecessary back-and-forth.

• Manage a steady daily caseload, prioritize files by urgency and deadline, and keep reviews moving so settlements are filed on time.

• Maintain accurate status updates and notes in the firm's case management system.

What This Role Requires

•
High-volume capacity. You will review a large number of settlement documents on a daily and weekly basis and must maintain quality at that pace.

•
Deadline management. Hearing dates, filing deadlines, and client expectations drive the work. You must meet turnaround times consistently.

•
Strong organization. You will juggle multiple files at different stages at once, so you need a reliable system for tracking what's pending, what's corrected, and what's ready.

•
Time management and prioritization. You must decide quickly what needs attention first and adjust as priorities shift throughout the day.

•
Exceptional attention to detail. A single wrong date, amount, or missing term can delay a client's settlement, and precision is essential.

•
Clear, efficient communication. You will give concise, actionable feedback to the team and escalate issues when needed.

•
Independence with accountability. You will work through your queue with minimal supervision while knowing when to raise a concern.

• Comfortable with fast-paced work environments

• Excellent writing and verbal communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Candidates must be in good standing with the California State Bar

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with California workers' compensation, particularly on the applicant side.

• Familiarity with C&R drafting, WCAB approval requirements, and common OSA issues.

Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
Benefits
Our law firm offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance coverage. We also provide eligible employees with flexible time off plans including Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), and paid holidays.

Your mission is to build a global community of creator ambassadors for our brands - HelloFresh and Factor - producing content at scale: thousands of creators, paid on performance, feeding both our organic channels and our paid channels, specifically Meta.

You will be part of a global team across Berlin and New York, work directly with senior growth leadership, and manage multimillion-euro creator budgets.

Success looks like: A creator community that grows month over month and stays active: creators onboard quickly, post consistently, and earn meaningfully. The program becomes a reliable source of content at scale - thousands of posts feeding organic reach - and a standing pipeline of creative for paid, acquiring customers at a cost that beats our existing channels.

You will own… 

• Program strategy and commercial model. Design how creators earn: commissions, rewards, challenges and progression tiers. Own the program's unit economics and budget, and iterate the model on live performance data.

• Creator activation, coaching and community. Run the creator community day to day: onboarding, coaching and training creators to produce content that converts, celebrating wins, and steering everyone toward what works. Develop the best creators into long-term brand ambassadors.

• Paid amplification. Amplify winning organic content into a pipeline of performing ads, aligning creator incentives with paid channel performance.

• Global rollout. Take the proven playbook to new brands and markets: adapt incentives and localize the model per market, set cross-market benchmarks, and report progress to Group leadership.

• Operations at leverage. Direct the program's platform, tooling and outsourced support teams so the program scales to thousands of creators without scaling headcount.

You are… 

• Well versed in performance terms: incentives, funnels and unit economics come naturally to you, and you iterate on data rather than opinions.

• An operator at heart: hands-on, structured, and comfortable building something new with high autonomy and leverage rather than a large team.

• Able to work fluently across functions and geographies, from paid social to finance, from Berlin to New York.

You have… 

• Built and scaled a creator, ambassador or affiliate program before, and you know what it takes to grow one from its early days to thousands of creators.

• Community instinct - you understand what keeps creators motivated, posting and loyal to a brand.

You’ll get… 

• Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

• Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)

• Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)   

• Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

• Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own our larger accounts and multi-phase programs, from signed contract through discovery, build, launch and the first months after go-live.

This is a senior delivery role. You are accountable for the budget, scope, timeline, and the customer relationship on every project you run, and you carry the conversations that come with them. We want someone who has already managed complex enterprise implementations, understands the challenges of ERP integration, and who has worked in a delivery model where AI does a meaningful share of the work. In this model, you understand that the project manager’s job is to make sure the work is defined well enough for AI and human steps to flow smoothly and with minimal intervention.

What you will do

• Own the project from signature to post-launch and deliver it on time, in scope, and on budget.

• Turn the contract into a work breakdown with estimates that roll up to the sold number, and close discovery with the Solution Architect on that basis.

• Keep the backlog ready. Every piece of work has a trace to the agreed solution design, acceptance criteria, an estimate and its dependencies before it goes to the team.

• Keep the project record complete, with every project meeting recorded and filed so the design, the plan and the team’s AI tools can work from it.

• Run the project week to week. Record and communicate budget burn, risks and mitigations, blockers with an owner and a date, dependencies on the customer’s IT and ERP partners, and a status the sponsor can act on without a call.

• Carry the hard conversations. When scope or expectations drift, say what it costs, defend the team’s estimate and the agreed scope, and route the rest through change control.

• Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.

• Seven or more years managing software implementation projects with a contracted budget for enterprise customers, with commerce, PIM or ERP integration projects in the Microsoft ecosystem strongly preferred.

• Experience delivering in an AI-accelerated methodology, where meeting records, solution design and backlog quality are what the AI tools and the engineers build from, and where you have seen what happens when they are not in order.

• A track record of turning a Statement of Work and its change orders into a work breakdown that rolls up to the contract, and of holding that number through delivery.

• Working knowledge of Dynamics 365 from the project side, enough to understand what the integration work is and why it takes the time it does.

• Fluent with the work management, time tracking and financial tools a delivery team runs on, and used to keeping them reconciled.

• Reads budget burn and acts on a deviation before it becomes an overrun.

title: Head of Procurement
description:
Hi, I’m Shane and I’m the VP of Finance & Ops at Ashby. We move fast and thoughtfully at Ashby, and we want buying to feel the same way. Too many companies build procurement processes that slow the business down in the name of saving a few dollars or eliminating outlier risks. We want a process that’s simple and fast by default yet intelligent enough to create friction where it’s needed and eliminate it where it’s not. That means building systems that route vendor decisions to the right stakeholders when risks call for it, and gets out of the way when it doesn’t. This role isn’t about becoming the single point of approval for every purchase, but rather it’s about designing the system and judgment that enables our company to move quickly on the small stuff while making sure complicated and higher-risk decisions get the input and oversight they deserve. This is an ownership role. You’ll operate with a significant amount of autonomy in shaping how procurement works at Ashby.

Your initial responsibilities will include:

- Designing, implementing, and administering Ashby’s procurement process from the ground up: fast and frictionless by default, with intelligent escalation pathways that pull in IT, Legal, Security, Finance, and Founder review when the vendor, contract, or spend calls for it.

- Creating a clear, consolidated view of company-wide vendor spend.

- Tuning and administering our existing procurement tool, and evaluating replacement options as it comes up for renewal.

- Leading negotiation and contract structuring on our largest and most complex vendor relationships, either directly or in close partnership with the business leader who owns the relationship.

- Equipping business leaders with the tools and guardrails to own the vendor relationships that make sense for them to own directly.

- Partnering with IT, Legal, Security, and Finance to design the escalation process and ensure it’s working as intended.

You should apply if:

- You have significant experience, primarily in procurement or vendor management with a high-growth tech environment. You’ve done this before, not just procurement, but procurement at a company that was really moving quickly.

- You think in systems. You’re as excited about designing a fast and efficient procurement process as you are about negotiating a critical contract.

- You have a bias towards speed and simplicity. You’re allergic to processes that slow everyone down to guard against a small number of edge cases.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity and building the playbooks on your own. While we have a process and some structure in place, there is a lot of greenfield and you’ll need the confidence and perspective to build for the future.

- You take pride in getting the economics right on a deal but not at the risk of ruining an important vendor relationship.

- You have strong opinions on what good looks like. Whether it’s a review-routing framework or a vendor evaluation methodology, your views are rooted in principled thinking.

Why you shouldn’t apply:

- You expect a mature, established process to step into. What exists today needs real tuning and reshaping, not just light maintenance. If you’d rather inherit a finished system than rebuild one, this won’t be the right fit.

- You treat negotiation as a win-at-all-costs game. Getting good economics matters, but not by squeezing a vendor so hard that the relationship is soured. Being on the other side of this isn’t pleasant and it’s important you are aligned with this. If your instinct is to optimize for the deal over the relationship, you’ll create problems that we’re trying to prevent.

- You want to be the approver for every purchase. If your instinct is to insert yourself into every buying decision rather than equip the company to move fast within the right guardrails, you’ll be fighting the design of this role.

As a Staff Data Engineer on the Migrations team , you are the end-to-end technical and operational owner of client migrations. You will drive the full lifecycle, from deep-dive legacy analysis to production deployment, while orchestrating collaboration across Operations, Client Success, Product, Data Science and Platform Engineering. You don't just implement; you own the outcome.
This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role for someone who can think like an architect, execute like a senior engineer, and coordinate like a program manager - all on the same project. You'll own the problem space from discovery to go-live, making the defining architectural decisions and writing the code that brings them to life.

Lead discovery & technical due diligence - get to the bottom of poorly documented legacy systems (ETL, stored procedures, reporting layers, file feeds), reconstruct the business logic, and capture it in the lineage maps, mapping specs, and risk analyses everyone builds from.

Reverse-engineer complex legacy systems using agents- you will be responsible for reverse-engineering complex, undocumented legacy systems (SSIS packages, stored procedures) where business logic is embedded, not documented. Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour
About the Role
This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.
This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication , with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day . The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.
Key Responsibilities
1. Appointment Scheduling

• Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.

• Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.

• Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

• Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.

• Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.

• Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

• Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.

• Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.

• Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

• Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.

• Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.

• Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

• Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.

• Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.

• Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

• Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.

• Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

title: US LBM Domain Architect
description:
US LBM is one of the leading and fastest growing distributors of specialty building materials in the United States, with a team of over 13,000 employees located throughout the country. Since our founding in 2009, we have acquired over 100 companies and have expanded to more than 450 locations serving 37 states. US LBM is a progressive organization that promotes a unique culture that focuses on the value of its customers and associates. Developing our people is critical to our strategy and fostering our culture of empowerment.
.
A Brief Overview

The US LBM Domain Architect plays a critical role in translating enterprise architecture strategy into practical, scalable technology solutions within a defined business domain (e.g., Customer, Commerce, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Data, or Integration). This person is responsible for defining and governing domain-level architecture, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, and partnering closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to drive successful solution delivery. This role bridges enterprise architecture vision and delivery execution, ensuring that solutions across the domain are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with long-term strategy.

What you will do

• Domain Architecture Leadership - Own the architecture strategy and roadmap for a defined domain. Translate enterprise architecture principles into domain patterns. Define applications, services, data flows, and integrations.

• Solution Design & Governance - Lead architecture reviews and design sessions. Ensure alignment with standards, security, and scalability. Govern architectural consistency across the domain.

• Cross-Team Collaboration - Partner with engineering, product, platform, and data teams. Act as bridge between enterprise architecture and delivery.

• Architecture Standards & Patterns - Develop reference architectures and reusable patterns. Promote platform-first and event-driven approaches.

• Technology Evaluation - Evaluate new technologies and platforms. Support build vs buy decisions and vendor selection.

• Domain Roadmap Alignment - Maintain multi-year roadmap aligned to enterprise strategy.

• Participate in and complete assigned trainings.

• Experience with microservices, APIs, event-driven systems

• Extensive understanding in using AI first development and research

• Strong understanding of application, data, and cloud architecture

• Modern data architectures

• Security and identity frameworks

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement

• Influence without authority

• Strategic and execution-oriented mindset

• Mentorship capability

title: Publishing Editor
description:
Join us and be part of a mission-driven, independent publisher. You’ll work with a diverse group of people who share a passion for empowering researchers, educators, and institutions to shape the future.
About Sage :
Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Believing that research and education are critical in shaping society, Sara Miller McCune founded Sage in 1965. Today, we are controlled by a group of trustees charged with maintaining our independence and mission indefinitely.
Our guaranteed independence means we’re free to:

• Do more - supporting an equitable academic future, furthering disciplines that drive social change, and helping social and behavioural science make an impact

• Work together - building lasting relationships, championing diverse perspectives, and co-creating resources to transform teaching and learning

• Think long-term - experimenting, taking risks, and investing in new ideas

About our Team:

The Hybrid & Open Access Journals Editorial team is a vibrant and dynamic team of highly motivated individuals who are passionate about research and publishing. We are responsible for developing and growing a diverse portfolio of high-quality, valuable journals across the social sciences, STEM fields, and various business models to adapt to a changing market. Our collaborative efforts with external editors, society partners, and internal colleagues in editorial, marketing, and product innovation roles ensure the growth, success, and long-term sustainability of our program. Our friendly and welcoming team is dedicated to driving excellence and fostering a supportive environment.
Could you be our new Publishing Editor? Are you?

• Experienced in managing academic or scientific journals with a record of improving editorial performance and journal impact?

• Confident in navigating the full journal publishing lifecycle, from submission and peer review to production and distribution?

• Skilled in written and verbal communication, able to influence, negotiate and represent your organisation at industry events?

• A strategic thinker, capable of analysing financial performance, increasing revenue, and being responsible for costs?

• A relationship-builder, known for encouraging positive relationships with editors, societies, and internal teams to drive journal success?

• Equipped to handle ethical and legal publishing challenges, ensuring compliance and integrity across all editorial activities?

Your new role:
You’ll be at the heart of shaping the future of academic research by leading a dynamic portfolio of journals - enhancing their quality, visibility, and market impact while driving financial performance. You’ll build trusted relationships with editorial boards and publishing partners, offering guidance and service that empowers them to thrive.

• Monitor the financial performance of journals in the assigned portfolio, maximising revenues and controlling costs.

• Provide information and advice to journal editors and partner societies to help them improve the quality of content published across journals.

• Compile and assess key data and metrics, using this data to advise recommendations on each journal’s development strategy.

• Lead journal editorial board meetings and represent Sage at conferences, where appropriate.

• Successfully negotiate editor and society contract renewals, prepare draft contracts and lead contract approval process through to contract signature.

• Coordinate cross departmentally so that journals are produced, marketed and distributed in an appropriate way and within acceptable costs.

• Actively manage journal editor performance, establishing and implementing best practice regarding manuscript submission, peer review process, revision and resubmission policies, and optimal editorial board function.
